Alternatives to Trish McEvoy Instant Eye Lift (x-posted to r/makeupaddiction)
I've been using the Trish McEvoy Instant Eye Lift (01) for the past couple years and I absolutely love it. It covers my undereye circles really well and doesn't settle into the fine lines nor does it feel heavy like some concealers can. I also love the way it smells and how easy it is to apply. That said, it's a bit out of my price range at the moment. I'm looking for a similar undereye illuminator product that's under $30. Has anyone used the Instant Eye Lift and found a similar product? I'm somewhat in between a MAC NC20 and MUFE Pro Finish Powder Foundation 120 Neural Ivory, if that helps narrow the options.

Thanks!
